newsitem.title: USA: SanDisk sees margins hurt by product shift.
newsitem.headline: SanDisk sees margins hurt by product shift.

text.p: SanDisk Corp on Monday said several camera makers began selling digital cameras with 2MB CompactFlash supplied by the company during the first quarter.
The low-capacity CompactFlash carries lower gross margins, which hurt the company's overall gross margins in the first quarter, SanDisk said.

The company, which makes flash memory data-storage products for electronic systems, said it expected the trend to extend into the coming quarters while the market moves to cameras using a higher-capacity CompactFlash, which carries better gross margins.
